summary: Hover-to-select on the Detect tool (part 1, no download - UI over detections we already have) + a COCO YOLO -seg model so the detector covers everyday objects (part 2). Replaces the cancelled MPI-361 Phase B.

Returned to todo/planned - NO code was written. Detect is TWO round trips (run 1 = positionless SEGSPreview crops, run 2 = masks for picks only), so hover needs run 1 to return all masks; user chose that (option A) but wants the next session to brainstorm the masking system first. attention: required.
Blocked on a masking-system brainstorm before implementation.
Masking brainstorm outcome folded in: segm-folder enumerator, per-region labels, labels-string filtering, hybrid click-to-refine, thumb strip and Detect button dropped. Depends on MPI-380.
Recorded user candidate: hover shows a BOX not the blob - avoids a coarse mask being mistaken for output quality, and removes the per-pixel index map plus possibly the -seg model requirement.
Recorded late candidate: SAM3 open-vocabulary text may remove the need for Part 2 (COCO YOLO) entirely, leaving COCO justified only by a generic Objects bucket. Decide at implementation.

Moved to doing for a BRAINSTORM SESSION WITH THE USER - step 1 of the MPI-424 umbrella - NOT for implementation. The user's position 2026-08-01: what they want is a lot simpler than what this card proposes. Agenda in tasks/MPI-424/brief.md - the user states their model first, then box-vs-blob on hover, then whether Part 2 (COCO YOLO) survives at all, then whether the thumb strip and Detect button are really dropped on both tools, then auto-fire plus debounce decided with MPI-421 in view, then where the instant green on click comes from. Rule for the session: what the user rules out is deleted from the card, not demoted to another candidate - three rounds of parked options is the defect being fixed.

REJECTED by the user in the MPI-424 brainstorm this card was moved to doing for. The WHOLE card is dropped, not trimmed - including Part 1, the hover-to-select half that needed no download. User's words: what we have right now is fine as it is, and moving the selection onto the canvas is another layer of complexity that does not necessarily need to exist; he had been leaning this way before the session. The thumb strip STAYS, the Detect button STAYS, and Part 2 (COCO YOLO, its R2 upload, the bbox-vs-segm folder trap, its own coarse-mask quality problem) dies with it. Kept as the record rather than deleted: the live measurements on this card and in MPI-380's brief are still true and should be read before anyone re-proposes canvas-side selection - yolov8n-seg enumerates from the segm folder in 0.5s flat regardless of object count, hover CAN name a region via ImpactDecomposeSEGS, class filtering is the labels string only because preset does nothing server-side, and native segm masks are blobby enough that the hover preview would have read as poor output quality. Umbrella consequence: MPI-421 is no longer downstream of this card and gets SIMPLER - with the chip strip and Detect button staying, it is exactly what it says.
